_about: Where each section of a river listing starts and ends, read from the section's own wording in the Alberta sportfishing regulation tables. Breaks are located by scripts/build_sections.py: road = Government of Alberta road crossing by highway number or road name; trib = mouth of the named stream (FWMIS); lake = where the river enters (in) or leaves (out) the named lake (FWMIS); osm = a named OpenStreetMap feature (falls, day-use area); ats = Alberta Township System location (LSD-section-township-range-meridian), snapped to a road crossing when road=true; head / mouth = ends of the mapped provincial river. main/tribs say whether the section covers the mainstem and/or its tributaries. A break that can't be located leaves the river unsplit.
